body: EQT launched an unsecured commercial paper program with capacity up to $3.5 billion to fund general corporate needs, including working capital, capital expenditures, acquisitions, and debt repayment. The company entered commercial paper dealer agreements to sell notes at par or a discount with maturities up to 397 days and executed an issuing and paying agent agreement with a national bank to administer the program. EQT expects its senior unsecured revolving credit facility to serve as a liquidity backstop and intends to maintain capacity at least equal to notes outstanding.
